name: Compliance
job: Sole writer of sms_consent_status and DND state. Owns v2_status_dnd, v2_email_bounced, v2_bad_number. Not a middleware.

filters: field = sms_consent_status OR DND state OR email_bounced OR bad_number
trigger.notes: Also enrolled via ADD-TO-WF from WF-05 MUT branch.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Compliance state changed (consent | DND | bounce | bad number)
named_steps.comment: Sole compliance writer. Must not proxy for another workflow (not middleware).

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Branch on compliance signal
named_steps.comment: Splits into consent, DND, email bounce, bad number lanes.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: DND channels (sole writer)
named_steps.comment: Only WF-11 writes DND. Must not toggle DND from any other workflow.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_status_dnd (DND branch)
named_steps.comment: New v2 DND tag. Must not remove sms-consent live tag.

named_steps.name: REMOVE-FROM-WF: Drop from outreach WFs (WF-02, WF-03, WF-04, WF-08, WF-09)
named_steps.comment: Stops in-flight outreach when compliance flips. Must not remove from WF-05 (routing must still process).
